1: # Copy this file to .env and fill in real values. Never commit .env.
2: 
3: # Google Gemini API key — powers /api/chat and /api/analyze-photo.
4: # Without it those endpoints return status NO_GEMINI_KEY and the site
5: # falls back to its offline chatbot responses.
6: GEMINI_API_KEY=
7: 
8: # Google Places API key — powers /api/reviews (live Google review cards).
9: # Enable "Places API (New)" in Google Cloud Console.
10: # Place IDs: find via https://developers.google.com/maps/documentation/places/web-service/place-id
11: GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY=
12: PLACES_ID_JAIPUR=
13: PLACES_ID_SIKAR=
14: PLACES_ID_AJMER=
15: 
16: # Shared token protecting the admin dashboard APIs. The admin page asks
17: # for this value once and stores it in the browser. Leave it blank and
18: # the admin API stays disabled (returns 503) rather than open.
19: # Generate one with: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"
20: ADMIN_TOKEN=
21: 
22: # Google Apps Script webhook that appends leads to the clinic spreadsheet.
23: # Falls back to the URL hardcoded in server.js when unset.
24: SHEET_WEBHOOK_URL=
25: 
26: # Where captured leads are stored on disk (JSON).
27: LEAD_STORE_PATH=./data/leads.json
28: 
29: # Server port. Defaults to 3001.
30: PORT=3001
31:

33: NODE_ENV=development
